title: What is your food court like?
content: My food courts are always on the top floor, with the tables and chairs around the glass railings that look down at the rest of the mall. It's usually divided into two sides. One side has regular food court step up, with stalls of foods you'd expect. Burger place, pretzel place, asian, Mexican, etc. And the other side is the fancy restaurants. I can never remember the names though. The one I go to has deep dark brown wood walls, and a breakfast buffet, that's separated into little sections. At the front is one of those water fountains that flow down the wall. There's also a lot of plants. What is your food court like? Has anybody else been to my fancy restaurant?
